fusions.name: Gather In
fusions.desc: Drags every enemy near a line 5 tiles long inward for 5 seconds, dealing 10 damage. Your afflictions on a target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tidy Sweep
fusions.desc: A raking blow that deals 8 damage to a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses that affliction up.

fusions.name: Leavings Pile
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once and heal you. Unfed, a stack fades every 12 seconds.
